status: Product pictures come from the repository README’s native captures in docs/screenshots/readme/. Seven full-size 2960×1946 PNGs are byte-for-byte copies of native Wayland captures from a clean release build of 0cd375246c4688ae7e76058c2f137f6eb117be30 on Omarchy 4.5, showing a disposable demo repository (and the offline GitHub review fixture). The three responsive tour WebPs and social sharing card are derivatives of those captures. The whole-monitor Omarchy desktop sheet retains its verified November 16 capture from 025eaf40bf3b1f565b4488bd4434e2e3b1c6c141. Each derivative records its source hash and method.

assets.method: Resize the complete 2960 × 1946 opaque sRGB capture to 1200 × 789 and encode lossless WebP with ImageMagick 7.1.2-34 / libwebp 1.6.0. Command: magick <source> -filter Lanczos -resize 1200x -depth 8 -define webp:lossless=true -define webp:method=6 <site_path>.
